issues.failure_explanation: No hypothesis \alpha>0 is imposed. If \alpha=0 and a nonzero pressure mode satisfies \Pizero{k}p_h=0, then b_h(\v_h,p_h)=0 for every velocity and the pressure stabilization is absent, so B_h[(0,p_h),(\v_h,q_h)]=0 for every test pair. Such nonpolynomial kernel modes are precisely why c_h was introduced. Therefore the claimed inf-sup bound, and hence uniqueness, cannot hold over the stated parameter range.
